newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Glorious Sun's JeansWest sets expansion.
newsitem.headline: Glorious Sun's JeansWest sets expansion.

text.p: Casual clothing retailer JeansWest Australia on Thursday launched a A$10 million marketing and expansion plan for Australia and New Zealand.

JeansWest, a subsidiary of Hong Kong's Glorious Sun Enterprises Ltd, said at least 30 new stores would be opened in Australia and New Zealand before next March and existing outlets would be refitted as part of the new marketing strategy.
"Trading conditions are severe in the clothing retailing industry and 1997 is shaping up as tougher than 1996," JeansWest managing director David Lawn said in a statement.

"All retailers will have to fight hard for their sales, but we believe this innovative marketing strategy combined with the store expansion program will give us an edge and allow us to continue our strong sales growth record," Lawn said.

Glorious Sun Enterprises last September launched a successful public offering of 250 million shares and said at the time proceeds would be used to expand its JeansWest retail network in Australia, New Zealand and China.
Glorious Sun has an expansion programme seeking to launch "1,000 stores in 100 cities" throughout China, Australia and New Zealand by 2000.
JeansWest's major competitors are JustJeans Ltd, Country Road Ltd and David Jones Ltd.
